description: Fork of exp072 (val=1.6975 @ 8K, current best). Replace qk_joint TinyMultiHeadLut with PermutationalLut producing [B*T, H, 2048] (split into Q and K halves of 1024 each). Each 1024-dim output is treated as sparse dominance scores in a virtual d_qk=128 ranking space (P_full=8128). SparseDominanceCanonicalize (one shared between Q and K) projects each 1024-dim sparse dom -> Borda-128 -> back to sparse 1024-dim via per-head random pair indices (tied between D2V and V2D). SDPA on [B, H, T, 1024] sparse dominance for both Q and K. V LUT and out_proj unchanged.
